# Repo Notes

Housekeeping notes for this profile repository.

## Layout

- `README.md` — the profile README rendered on the GitHub profile page
- `assets/` — images referenced by the README; `activity-*.svg` are generated, do not edit by hand
- `.github/scripts/activity.py` — renders the 30-day activity card from the contribution calendar
- `.github/` — repository metadata

## Conventions

Keep the profile README self-contained; link out rather than inlining large content.
